records.context: Image data channel-Adaptive DINO encodes each image layer on its own and returns the class tokens of every image layer side by side, as its official bag-of-image data channels evaluation does.
records.label: spacr.embeddings._cell_dino_model.forward#1
records.source: Channel-Adaptive DINO encodes each plane on its own and returns the class tokens of every plane side by side, as its official bag-of-channels evaluation does.
records.translation: Channel-Adaptive DINO 单独编码每个图像平面，并将所有图像平面的类别令牌并排返回，与其官方 bag-of-channels 评估方式一致。

records.context: Each image layer of each extracted image region is centred and scaled to unit standard deviation after resizing, as the official evaluation transform does.
records.label: spacr.embeddings._foundation_encoder.run#1
records.source: Each plane of each crop is centred and scaled to unit standard deviation after resizing, as the official evaluation transform does.
records.translation: 调整尺寸后，每个裁剪图像的每个图像平面都会被中心化并缩放到单位标准差，与官方评估变换一致。

records.context: Encode ``(n, h, w, k)`` extracted image regions in model-appropriate batches.
records.label: spacr.embeddings._foundation_encoder.run#2
records.source: Encode ``(n, h, w, k)`` crops in model-appropriate batches.
records.translation: 以适合模型的批次编码形状为 ``(n, h, w, k)`` 的裁剪图像。

records.context: float32 extracted image regions, image-channel-last. SubCell R/Y/B/G uses native intensity values; other foundations expect [0, 1].
records.label: spacr.embeddings._foundation_encoder.run#3
records.source: float32 crops, channels last. SubCell R/Y/B/G uses native intensity values; other foundations expect [0, 1].
records.translation: float32 裁剪图像，通道位于最后一个维度。SubCell R/Y/B/G 使用原始强度值；其他基础模型要求数值位于 [0, 1]。

records.context: Show the image layers the chosen factory takes; none when adaptive.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings.EmbeddingsScreen._cell_dino_dialog.sync_width#0
records.source: Show the planes the chosen factory takes; none when adaptive.
records.translation: 显示所选模型构建函数接受的图像平面；自适应时不显示任何平面。

records.context: Fill the file and its detected model; the digest is read on OK.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings.EmbeddingsScreen._cell_dino_dialog.use_installed#0
records.source: Fill the file and its detected model; the digest is read on OK.
records.translation: 填入文件及其检测到的模型；摘要在点击 OK 时读取。
